name: Sei Oukoku Foria ~Mawaru Toki - Sokubakusareta Tamashii~ -Ouhi Hen-
original_name: 聖王国フォーリア ～廻る時 束縛された魂～ -王妃編-
source:
Queen Rosalietta of Fouria was at the apex of her womanhood. Mature and beautiful in her late 30s, she was widowed upon the passing of her ill husband King Legrus, and was now Fouria's highest regent.

Fouria was very busy with the Festival of the Beast, the return and coronation of the princess Anne Rose that would take place in two weeks. At this time, Legrus's cousin and Hand of the King, Castol, put his devious plan into action.

Rosalietta's soul was bound in the forbidden curse of "Rin-ne Damashibaku", making her helpless to whatever perverse act Castol desired... her soul that soon degraded into a raunchy harlot...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ100223.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
富里亚王后罗莎莉埃塔正处于女性事业的巅峰。她三十多岁成熟美丽，在生病的丈夫莱格鲁斯国王去世后成为寡妇，现在是弗里亚的最高摄政王。

弗莉亚正忙着庆祝野兽节，以及两周后将举行的安妮·罗斯公主的归来和加冕礼。这时，雷格勒斯的表弟、国王之手卡斯托尔将他的邪恶计划付诸实施。

罗莎莉埃塔的灵魂被“轮回魂爆”的禁忌诅咒所束缚，使她对卡斯托尔想要的任何邪恶行为都无能为力……她的灵魂很快就堕落为一个不修边幅的妓女……
